pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does mulch do? (1 mark)
   A. Adds plastic to the soil
   B. Kills the plant
   C. Makes the soil hot
   D. Keeps the soil moist by reducing evaporation

2. Which of these is an energy-giving fat? (1 mark)
   A. Beans
   B. Cooking oil
   C. Oranges
   D. Spinach

3. Why are tins with pebbles tied on a scarecrow? (1 mark)
   A. They make noise and flash to frighten animals
   B. They store water
   C. They make it heavy
   D. They feed birds

4. Which drink is best with meals? (1 mark)
   A. Dirty water
   B. Only soda
   C. Clean water
   D. Only sugary juice

5. Which of these is used for shallow frying? (1 mark)
   A. A cup
   B. A bowl
   C. A frying pan
   D. A bucket

6. Why should tacking thread not be pulled tight? (1 mark)
   A. The cloth will wrinkle
   B. It will not hold
   C. Thread is expensive
   D. It will become long

7. Which tool gives gentle watering of a seedbed? (1 mark)
   A. Bucket poured fast
   B. Hose without a nozzle
   C. Watering can with a fine rose
   D. Cup thrown from far

8. Why should you wash hands after removing gloves? (1 mark)
   A. Gloves are wet
   B. Hands may still have germs
   C. Gloves are heavy
   D. To dry the gloves

9. Which way should you open a lid on a hot pot? (1 mark)
   A. Straight toward your face
   B. Under water
   C. Away from your face
   D. Fast and close

10. Which is a benefit of using less fuel? (1 mark)
   A. More trees must be cut
   B. The family spends more
   C. More smoke is made
   D. The family saves money

11. Which of these is a fuel used at home for cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Charcoal
   B. Glass
   C. Cloth
   D. Sand

12. Why should you wear clean clothes? (1 mark)
   A. To save water
   B. To make the clothes wear out
   C. Dirty clothes can carry germs and smell
   D. To get tired

13. Which way should pot handles point? (1 mark)
   A. Down into the fire
   B. Inward, away from the edge
   C. Outward over the floor
   D. Towards children

14. Why should the drip container be covered? (1 mark)
   A. To warm the water
   B. To increase evaporation
   C. To keep out leaves and mosquitoes
   D. To make water sweet

15. Why should you avoid climbing thin branches while harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. They can break and you may fall
   B. They are too sweet
   C. They are cold
   D. They are too high

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three signs that fruit is ripe, naming the fruit. (3 marks)

17. Explain why a scarecrow becomes less useful if it is never moved. (3 marks)

18. Name three foods that are boiled. (3 marks)

19. Describe how to wash hands correctly. (4 marks)

20. Why should a thread colour different from the cloth be used? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Keeps the soil moist by reducing evaporation
   A covering of dry grass slows down drying of the soil.

2. B — Cooking oil
   Oils give a lot of energy.

3. A — They make noise and flash to frighten animals
   Noise and movement scare animals.

4. C — Clean water
   Water is essential and healthy.

5. C — A frying pan
   A flat pan holds a little oil.

6. A — The cloth will wrinkle
   Loose stitches lie flat.

7. C — Watering can with a fine rose
   Fine spray does not wash seeds away.

8. B — Hands may still have germs
   Germs can get on hands.

9. C — Away from your face
   Steam can burn.

10. D — The family saves money
   Buying less fuel means spending less.

11. A — Charcoal
   Charcoal is burnt to give heat.

12. C — Dirty clothes can carry germs and smell
   Clean clothes keep us fresh.

13. B — Inward, away from the edge
   Handles sticking out can be knocked.

14. C — To keep out leaves and mosquitoes
   A cover keeps water clean and stops mosquitoes breeding.

15. A — They can break and you may fall
   Safety while picking fruit.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Passion fruit turns purple or yellow and wrinkles; guava turns yellowish and smells sweet; pawpaw turns yellow or orange and gives when pressed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sign with fruit.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Birds and animals soon notice it never moves, learn that it is harmless, and come back to eat the crops.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for noticing, 1 mark for learning it is harmless, 1 mark for returning to the crops.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Potatoes, eggs, cassava, maize, beans, rice (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each food.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wet hands; use soap; rub palms, backs of hands, between fingers, thumbs and nails for about 20 seconds; rinse; dry with a clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four correct steps.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The stitches are easy to see and to remove.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
